### Data Scope Notes

- This data is built specifically for Red Hat. In **Apptio / ITPF** context, "vendor spend" means **IT** planning vendor lines — not a substitute for **GL** booked vendor totals for IT actuals.
- Apptio is **IT only** and **enriches** financial/GL lineage with planning dimensions; it does not replace GL/OneStream for company-wide books or budget variance.
- Non-IT spend (e.g. vending machines, facilities, non-IT departments) is not in Apptio — use GL/OneStream.
- Apptio does not contain lease data (Example: RH tower).
- Not all Apptio data is represented in this data product. For additional context, refer users to:
  - **Apptio Portal**: https://redhatit.apptio.com/
  - **Contact**: TBMO@redhat.com
